briefHtml:
NAV S$10,096,345 - reported -0.76% (stale baseline), recorded -0.03% d/d (Monday restated up to S$10,099,584; ~S$15k above yesterday's headline)

  • Biggest mover: NVDA +31.6% to $165.05 on Jensen Huang's reinstatement (not held). Book-level: silver futures +4.9% to ~$43.10 - leveraged IBKR line recovers to ~1.76x, equity ~S$42,700
  • The one thing: a Trump-brokered CEO return triggered the best US session since Apr 2025 (SPX +4.7%, Nasdaq +6.5%, Dow +1,448 pts), but Nomura's McElligott calls it a mechanical short-covering bounce that guarantees nothing - into a Thanksgiving-thinned week with October PCE Wednesday. Bases are not built in one session.

Markets

  • US Mon: SPX +4.7% (ends 7-day losing streak, best day since Apr 2025); Dow 49,595.31 +3.01%; Nasdaq +6.5% (2nd-biggest points gain ever); NVDA $165.05 +31.6% (Huang reinstated; Trump convinced the board; Kress back as CFO); MU/MRVL +18%, INTC +16%, SOXX +14%; ANT ~$87 -1% (above $83 IPO); CRWD -9-10% on ~$44bn all-stock Zscaler bid; VIX 26.62 (from 35.89); 10y ~4.92-4.94%
  • Metals: gold futures $3,635 +3.4%; silver futures ~$43.10 +4.9% (2:27pm ET); BTC $61,300; WTI $80.25 -3.8%
  • Asia Mon: STI 4,953.81 -0.43% (sub-5,000); HSI 22,383.74 -0.12%; Tencent HK$344.00 exactly 0.00%; Xiaomi HK$27.52 -0.43%; DBS S$65.76 -0.53% (ex-div S$0.81 on 11-13); SSE +0.15%; Europe rallied (CAC +1.48%, STOXX50 +2.23%)
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2914; USDCNY ~6.66; USDHKD ~7.84

Flags

  • 8 critical flags - all 5-session windows anchored to 11-16 closes, mislabeled in a day (Tencent HK$344.00 vs 390.40 exact; Xiaomi 27.52 vs 29.08 exact; DBS S$65.76 vs 69.30 exact, ex-div S$0.81 inflates the slide)
  • Silver -4.3% leveraged-line flag is backward-looking: futures rallied +4.9% Monday; line ~1.76x not the implied distress
  • Listed book -4.58% is the same artefact; recorded NAV -0.03% d/d is the truth. L46.SI Yahoo 404 - 39th session

Insider trades

  • None found (SGX API 404 for the 10th straight trading day; Wing Tai pause 12 sessions; no HKEX disclosures for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi; US holdings are ETFs)

Congress trades

  • No new filings dated 11/18-11/23; most recent remain 11/16-11/17: FL-19 (buys IBKR; sells NFLX, ZTS, ADSK), CA-50 ($500k-1M T-Bill sale), IL-1 (DDOG buy, BP sell), AR-2 (JBGS sale), WA-1 ($250-500k San Joaquin bonds)
  • Source: Unusual Whales

Trump / policy

  • Trump told CNBC he convinced NVDA's board to reinstate Huang - the AI complex's single-name dependency is now explicitly a political dependency Yahoo Finance
  • Graham Act EO 14436: 500% Russia duties / 100% on top Russian-energy buyers - all waived indefinitely, including Russian-uranium provisions; uranium thesis stays structural, not sanctions-driven
  • Thanksgiving: US closed Thu, half-day Fri (1pm ET); October PCE lands Wednesday into thin liquidity; Dec 9 FOMC 25bp hike ~91-99% priced
  • Rare earths: Pentagon ban (EO 14415) from Jan 1 2027; China export-control pause expires Jan 10 - the nine-day squeeze window MINING.COM
  • Gold resets: Goldman cut end-2026 target $4,650 to $4,150 (UBS $4,500); central banks bought 321t in Q3; 10y real yield 2.88-2.89% goldsilver.com
  • Weekend optics: Trump gala for his plunging meme coin while retail was liquidated - sentiment color, not policy

Risk

  • Silver line (est.): collateral 1,777 oz x ~$43.10 x 1.2914 ~ S$98,900; loan ~S$56,240; equity ~S$42,700; ratio ~1.76x (from 1.67x Friday); -$1 silver = -S$2,292 equity; ~$33 = maintenance stress zone. Relieved, not safe
  • Bounce quality: mechanical short-covering per Nomura; VIX 26.62 still ~45% above its long-run average; rally lands in a holiday-shortened PCE week
  • FX ~35% non-SGD (USDSGD 1.2914, USDHKD ~7.84 peg edge); metals cluster still the dominant risk factor; DBS 2.0% of NW, -5.1% over five sessions

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Real assets (20%): gold V-bounced $3,513 to $3,635 without the required 2-3-session $3,500 hold - trigger unmet; watch $3,550-3,650 through Thanksgiving + PCE; silver line gets nothing
  • AI bottlenecks (15%, 0% deployed): NVDA reclaimed the $150-155 zone in one session ($165.05); floor re-test must survive the holiday tape; ANT above $83 intact; staged deployment armed, unconfirmed
  • Defense (15%): 10y 4.92-4.94% - the 5.20% gate is 26-28bp away and receding; deploy TLT in size AT the gate only

trumpWatch.title: Trump brokered Huang's NVDA return
trumpWatch.detail: Trump said on CNBC Monday he convinced NVDA's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO/president/director effective immediately; NVDA says the investigation continues but senior US government input found no national-security risk; Kress back as CFO. NVDA +31.6% to $165.05; the AI complex's single-name dependency is now explicitly a political dependency.

trumpWatch.title: Graham Act Russia tariffs waived indefinitely
trumpWatch.detail: EO 14436 (Oct 16) implements the Graham Act (signed Sep 18) - 500% duties on Russian goods, 100% on top-5 Russian-energy buyers - then waives substantially all of it in the same instrument under Section 115 national-interest certification, including the uranium import provisions; the Iran Sanctions Act extension is not waived. Waivers hold until the President or Secretary of State revisits them. Uranium thesis stays structural, not sanctions-driven.

trumpWatch.title: Thanksgiving week: PCE Wednesday, FOMC Dec 9
trumpWatch.detail: US markets closed Thu 11-26, early close 1pm ET Fri 11-27; Wednesday 11-25 is a full session with October PCE and Q3 GDP (2nd est.) at 8:30am ET; Fed blackout begins Sat 11-28. Dec 25bp hike priced ~91% (Polymarket) / ~92% (bond market) / ~99% (CME).

trumpWatch.title: Rare-earth deadlines calendared: Jan 1 US, Jan 10 China
trumpWatch.detail: EO 14415 enforcement: from Jan 1 2027 Pentagon contractors may not buy magnets, tantalum or tungsten mined, refined or separated in China, North Korea, Iran or Russia. China's rare-earth export-control pause expires Jan 10 2027, nine days later - a supply-squeeze window for defence suppliers.

trumpWatch.title: Gold resets: Goldman cuts target, central banks keep buying
trumpWatch.detail: Goldman cut its end-2026 gold target to $4,150 from $4,650 (UBS $4,500); gold is down 8%+ in November despite Monday's +3.4% V-bounce to $3,635; central banks bought 321t in Q3; 10y real yield 2.88-2.89%.

trumpWatch.title: ANT diverges from the NVDA bounce
trumpWatch.detail: Anthropic fell >1% to ~$87 Monday while NVDA ripped +31.6% - still above the $83 IPO price, but the AI complex's recovery is narrow and politically driven rather than broad demand. Weekend optics: Trump hosted a gala for his plunging meme coin while retail was being liquidated.

opportunities.thesis: Real assets (target 20%): gold V-bounced $3,513 to $3,635 futures (+3.4%) and silver futures +4.9% to ~$43.10 after last week's capitulation; Goldman cut end-2026 to $4,150 while central banks bought 321t in Q3; sixth straight physical silver deficit projected.
opportunities.signal: Trigger unmet - the required 2-3-session $3,500 gold hold never printed; watch whether $3,550-3,650 holds through Thanksgiving + PCE before any unlevered tranche; the leveraged silver line (~1.76x, equity ~S$42.7k) gets nothing

opportunities.thesis: AI bottlenecks (target 15%, 0% deployed): NVDA reclaimed the $150-155 zone in one session ($165.05, +31.6% on Huang's Trump-brokered return); ANT held above $83 but fell on the day - the bounce is narrow, political and mechanical (Nomura), not yet a base.
opportunities.signal: Staged deployment from the ~62% idle cash stays armed but unconfirmed: first tranche only after a 2-3 session base survives the holiday tape, never into a single-session V-bounce

opportunities.thesis: Defense (target 15%): 10y at 4.92-4.94%, little changed through the equity melt-up - the 5.20% gate is 26-28bp away and receding with a Dec hike ~91-99% priced.
opportunities.signal: Deploy in size AT the 5.20% gate only; if it does not arrive before Dec 9, that is acceptable - entry quality over calendar
